title: A warmer home for the work
question: Open a preview to see your real content. Choose a direction, or tell me what to change.

options.label: The open table
options.thesis: A welcoming personal introduction, followed by the work and the thinking behind it.
materials: Typography, real project images and generous reading space
options.viewport: A broad, friendly introduction with the three real project images directly below.
options.risk: Can feel too informal unless article typography remains disciplined.
options.lineage: The shared kitchen table: warm surfaces, clear places and room for conversation

raised.raise: Comfortable reading measure with notes kept beside the text.
Useful information remains close at hand without crowding the page.
Small-screen layouts change structure rather than merely shrinking.
A clear route through a long article and back to its contents.
A disciplined contrast system for all running text.
The same visual grammar follows you from project to writing.

options.label: The small press
options.thesis: A personal journal of practical engineering, with the projects as its illustrations.
materials: Typography, real project images and generous reading space
options.viewport: A serif introduction above a carefully set project spread and a compact list of essays.
options.risk: A familiar editorial direction; its distinction depends on the writing and real work.
options.lineage: Independent literary journals and small-press colophons

options.label: The annotated edition
options.thesis: A quiet reading room with helpful notes in the margins.
materials: Typography, real project images and generous reading space
options.viewport: A compact masthead and a two-column introduction beside an index of the work.
options.risk: The reference-book structure is more formal than conversational.
options.case: Strong recognition for technical readers; the open table explains the person and projects more immediately.

options.label: Dense web
options.thesis: A compact project and essay index organized into small ruled modules.
materials: Ruled content and a consistent navigation system
options.viewport: A compact project and essay index organized into small ruled modules.
options.risk: High information density competes with comfortable reading.
options.case: Too busy for the requested warm welcome.

options.label: Transforming cape
options.thesis: Sections gather around a common navigation line.
materials: Ruled content and a consistent navigation system
options.viewport: Sections gather around a common navigation line.
options.risk: The clothing metaphor distracts from the work.
options.case: Readers are unlikely to identify with a fashion interaction.

options.label: Deep dive
options.thesis: Writing follows a single vertical route with a persistent section index.
materials: Ruled content and a consistent navigation system
options.viewport: Writing follows a single vertical route with a persistent section index.
options.risk: An immersive environment is less personal.
options.case: The ocean setting obscures the engineering portfolio.

options.label: Data field
options.thesis: An index arranged in dense, high-contrast columns.
materials: Ruled content and a consistent navigation system
options.viewport: An index arranged in dense, high-contrast columns.
options.case: The data-art frame hides the person behind the site.

options.label: Cutting bench
options.thesis: Projects and essays sit along a horizontal selection rail.
materials: Ruled content and a consistent navigation system
options.viewport: Projects and essays sit along a horizontal selection rail.
options.risk: A film metaphor adds work to navigation.
options.case: The browsing ritual is less clear than ordinary links.

canonCard.label: A conventional personal portfolio
canonCard.thesis: A straightforward personal site with familiar navigation and simple project listings.
materials: Typography, real project images and generous reading space
canonCard.viewport: A short introduction, three selected projects and recent writing.
